caption: The drawing depicts two earrings against a plain, beige background. Each earring consists of a curved gold hook at the top, attached to a small, round element. Below this, there is an oval, bead-like component with a brown base color and diagonal gold stripes. At the bottom of each earring, there is a smaller spherical gold bead connected by a short gold link. The earrings are arranged apart from each other, with one shown from the front and the other in profile to display both the outer and side views. The overall color scheme is dominated by shades of brown and gold.
title: Earring
